steps.say: Alphabetical order means putting words in the order of the alphabet. Look at the first letter of each word.
If the first letters are the same, look at the second letter.
If the second letters are the same too, look at the third letter.
A dictionary lists words in alphabetical order. It tells you how to spell them and what they mean.
Guide words at the top of a page show its first and last words.

head: First word on the page
Last word on the page
figure.alt: A dictionary page with the guide words lamp and lemon.

steps.say: If your word comes between the guide words, it is on that page.

check.prompt: Which word comes first in alphabetical order?

options.why: P comes after e and n in the alphabet.
N comes after e in the alphabet.
S comes near the end of the alphabet.

hints: Look at the first letter of each word.
Which of p, e, n and s do you reach first?
check.explanation: E comes before n, p and s in the alphabet, so egg comes first.

check.prompt: The guide words are sand and sock. Which word is on this page?

options.why: Rice starts with r, so it comes before sand.
Su comes after so, so sun comes after sock.
Tap starts with t, so it comes after sock.

hints: The word must come after sand and before sock.
All the s words: compare their second letters.
Sand has a, sock has o. Which word has a second letter between a and o?
check.explanation: Sea starts with se. E comes after a and before o, so sea is between sand and sock.
